events.summary: Jace arrives late at the Chamber of the Guildpact to find Boros minotaurs complaining that the Orzhov have violated a boundary contract.
events.quote: The Orzhov violated our boundary contract!

events.summary: Jace rules that the minotaurs must file a proper complaint with Lavinia, and the lead minotaur sheathes his axe.
events.quote: You will file a proper complaint with Deputy Lavinia

events.summary: Lavinia shows Jace that victims of petrification were found in Rozlad Square arranged to spell his name.
Jace recognizes that the victims' names match planes, realizes a planeswalker is targeting him, and insists on going alone to Rozlad Square.
events.quote: Clear out all your officers and mages from Rozlad Square. I'm going alone.

events.summary: Jace meets a hooded woman with a dagger in the square; she is petrified before he can read her mind.
events.quote: She became a stone statue before his eyes, a lifeless object.

events.summary: Vraska reveals herself as a gorgon and planeswalker and says she wants Jace to prove he will be an ally of Ravnica.
Jace deduces that Vraska wants to rule Ravnica, and she declares she is ready to kill him; the Jace she looks at is only an illusion.
events.quote: Instead of turning to stone, Jace melted away into nothingness.

events.summary: The real Jace emerges and has Vraska send her four assassins away; he deduces she wants to control him as Guildpact.
events.quote: So you want to leave me in the office of the Guildpact, and manipulate me.

events.summary: Vraska threatens Jace's allies and mentions Garruk Wildspeaker, hinting that something has happened to him, and tells Jace he is a plague.
events.quote: You're a plague, Beleren. A scourge to all those you claim to protect.

events.summary: Vraska strangles Jace with her tendrils; he reads her mind and conjures illusions of himself that attack her.
events.quote: Jace felt the gorgon's grip loosen as he sent image after image of himself at her.

events.summary: Vraska petrifies the illusions, which become a cage around her, and the statues speak in Jace's voice and trick her into explaining her plan to take over Ravnica.
events.quote: Then, one by one, I will assassinate the guild leaders.

events.summary: The statues reveal that Vraska's words have been broadcast to the guild leaders gathered at Sunhome.
events.quote: Your statements have been broadcast to all those who've attended.

events.summary: Vraska crushes what she thinks is Jace's neck but it is her own petrified assassin; the statues close in and she blasts them away and planeswalks off.
events.quote: Then she took a breath, closed her eyes, and planeswalked away.

events.summary: Back at the Chamber, Lavinia reports the guilds now know of Vraska, and Jace, uneasy about Garruk, prepares to leave for a few days.
events.quote: And I think something's up with Garruk.

relations.note: Lavinia is Jace's aide and deputy at the Chamber.
relations.quote: formerly the Azorius maze runner and currently Jace's aide and deputy at the Chamber of the Guildpact

relations.note: Vraska tries to coerce or kill Jace; he outwits her.
relations.quote: I'm ready to kill you now.

relations.note: Jace is the Living Guildpact, embodiment of the concord between the guilds.
relations.quote: He was the embodiment of the concord between Ravnica's guilds

relations.note: Aurelia is guildmaster of the Boros.
relations.quote: Aurelia, guildmaster of the Boros, is hosting three other guild leaders at Sunhome tonight.

relations.note: The Boros accuse the Orzhov of violating a boundary contract.
relations.quote: They're collecting levies on Legion land!
Golgari turf. Near the tunnels of the Stonefare.

relations.quote: Four assassins, plus the one you killed yourself
